question: Should OpenClaw adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` plus `defaultAccount`, with named accounts inheriting shared root settings and existing root-level credentials remaining the legacy default account?
rationale: The branch is technically credible, but this choice defines a durable configuration, setup, credential, routing, and state-compatibility contract that cannot be inferred from tests or contributor demand alone.

options.title: Sponsor Current Contract
options.body: Confirm the additive account model and reopen this PR for final merge review without discarding its legacy and account-isolation coverage.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Specify different inheritance, migration, or setup semantics and invite a reduced replacement PR implementing that approved shape.

options.title: Decline Core Multi-Account
options.body: Keep the current single-bot Teams model and close the canonical feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Current Contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the additive account model and reopen this PR for final merge review without discarding its legacy and account-isolation coverage.
